articles.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
articles.snippet: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
articles.snippet: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
articles.snippet: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.

articles.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
articles.snippet: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.
